name: AppShell
description: Compose application navigation, a top bar and a workspace, with optional section drawer, inspector and phone navigation.
signature: ({ brand, rail, drawer, topBar, children, contentAs: Content, inspector, inspectorDefault, tabBar, drawerShortcut, focusRegions, className, }: AppShellProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: brand
props.description: Top-left corner, above the rail: the product mark (ShellBrand).

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: contentAs
props.description: Workspace element. Use div when embedding a shell inside an existing main landmark.

props.name: drawer
props.description: The current section's navigation (SectionDrawer). Optional per section.

props.name: drawerShortcut
props.description: Toggle the drawer from the keyboard. Default mod+b.

props.name: focusRegions
props.description:
F6 and Shift+F6 move between the top bar, rail, section drawer, workspace, inspector and
phone navigation, so a keyboard user can leave an editor where Tab belongs to the content.
Mark panes of your own inside the workspace with `data-focus-region`. See `useFocusRegions`.

props.name: inspector
props.description: Context pane (Inspector), docked beside the workspace on wide screens.

props.name: inspectorDefault
props.description:
Whether the inspector starts open before the person has chosen. `wide`: open at 120rem
(1920px) and wider, closed below. `closed`: closed at every width. Their stored choice, from
`InspectorToggle` or the pane's close button, always wins over this.
